payload.description: No input: every switched-on evaluator of every book is wanted.

reply.description: The switched-on evaluators of every book that have a question to ask, Your values among them when the user has values, in their places in the list. Each carries only its switched-on questions that can be asked.

id.description: The evaluator's id, which evaluators: evaluate takes.

description.description: What the evaluator checks, in the user's words; empty when the user wrote none.

book.description: The book the evaluator is kept with.

combined.description: A text passes when any question gets its expected answer, rather than every one (Your values: it serves at least one value). False when absent.

kind.description: yesno: answered Yes or No. pick: answered with one of the options, by name.

yes.description: What Yes means, for a yesno question; empty for none.

no.description: What No means, for a yesno question; empty for none.

options.description: The options of a pick question.

description.description: What the option means; empty for none.

expected.description: The answer a text should get, by name (Yes, No, or an option's name); absent when none is expected.

tool.description: Lists the reader's evaluators that are switched on: for each, its id, name, a description of what it checks, and its questions, each with what Yes and No mean or its options, and the answer a text should get. Use it to choose an evaluator, then check text with it through evaluators: evaluate.
tool.label: Listing your evaluators
